constraints: If menu is a MenuRef (menu reference), the process parameter is unnecessary and is ignored if passed.

The additional modifiers (Shift = 512, Option/Alt = 2048, summed if both apply) can only be set/reported when a standard shortcut has already been assigned via SET MENU ITEM SHORTCUT; returns 0 if the item has no associated modifier key.

overloadMerges.note: Added the -1 sentinel value documented for menuItem. Restored `returns` (Integer) from the parameter table's 'Function result' row -- apply_overload_merges replaces the whole overload from this merge entry's fields, so it was silently dropped even though the mechanical draft had correctly computed it.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Get the additional modifier key(s) (Shift and/or Option/Alt) combined with a menu item's standard shortcut key.

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to menu
